Utica, New York native Ronnie Zito has led a varied career as a drummer for Bobby Darin, the Woody Herman Orchestra, for numerous Broadway productions, and as a first-call musician for New York jazz gigs and studio work.
Ronnie was interviewed via Zoom on March 9, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, and Rick Montalbano, longtime friend of Ronnie and a previous interviewee of the Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ronnie Zito with me today along with my good pal Rick Montalbano. We are in three different places, musically I like to think we’re closer together.
So you’re still playing “Chicago” I guess.
